principles: Dispositions assigned to all 62 remaining P1 observations, regardless of evidence availability.
A bounded independent source may support only the narrow claim actually evidenced.
Partial or context-only witness cannot substantiate the exact Weiser claim.
No exact independent match means hold, not false claim that an exhaustive search disproved the custom.
No auto publication, priest blessing script, ritual substitution, additional 1962 Mass card, new Saints or Calendar record.
Do not elevate a holiday meal or regional object into a universal norm.
